business_problem: If you‘re a retailer trying to set up your e-commerce site, you might struggle to integrate your online storefront with back-end systems. Existing solutions like inventory, customer relationship management, and financial operations sometimes don’t talk to each other. This disconnection leads to inefficiencies and, ultimately, an unsatisfying customer experience. E-commerce isn’t just an online extension of physical stores; it's something that can drive businesses further. For that, you would need a comprehensive business solution.
